subject: Request: short-term sandbox extension for evening concurrency soak

Cc: Alex Morton <alex@finlytics.io>
Date: Fri, 10 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask — evening soak window for POC (Mar 22)

Hey Ava,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — both Alex and I came away confident about the routing/kv-cache benefits. We want to run a targeted evening soak (6pm–11pm PT) on Mar 22 to validate 95th- and 99th-percentile latency under peak concurrency for our chat workload.

High level ask: could Redwood temporarily increase our sandbox allowance or provide an ephemeral credit uplift so we can run ~2.5M tokens over that 5-hour window? We expect burst concurrency to hit ~550 rps for short periods.

I attached our soak plan (poc-soak-plan.xlsx) and traffic profile. If needed we can shift to the weekend but evening is ideal to match our users.

Big ask — tight timeline: we need confirmation by end of next week to lock internal ops.

Thanks,
—Harper

Hi Harper — appreciate the materials and the clear traffic profile. Looping in Ben (sales ops) and Priyom (solutions) to coordinate internal approvals and confirm technical constraints.

Short answers:
- We can support the 5-hour evening window, but it requires a temporary sandbox allowance increase or a short-term promo credit.
- We typically authorize ephemeral allowances up to 3M tokens for validated plans; anything above that needs manager sign-off.

Ben / Priyom — can you review the attached plan and advise on an approval path and any required paperwork? Harper: could you also confirm that the soak will only use the hosted sandbox (no Private deployment) and that you agree to the test safety rules in the last tab of the spreadsheet?

If we can get approval by Thursday EOD I can confirm the uplift and the exact token amount.

- 2.5M tokens over 5 hours is reasonable but we should scope headroom for retries and KV-cache warmup => recommend 3.25M tokens.
- Compliance: FinLytics confirmed no sensitive PII in test payloads per the plan, see row 7.
- Ops: we'll provision the uplift as a time-limited promo voucher tied to the deal. Voucher will auto-expire 48 hours after the soak window to avoid ongoing exposure.

Marissa — requesting manager approval for a one-time promo uplift of 3.25M tokens (non-refundable sandbox credit) and opt-in to extended logs retention for that run (30 days) for troubleshooting.

Attachments: previous-soak-summary.pdf (internal summary), expected-traffic-profile.json
